summary: The Discord Battleground is the central warfront of the War‑Shade Expanse — a chaotic arena where Discord energy fuels endless conflict. War‑Shades rise from shadow rifts, Muramite commanders test their armies, and Discord‑forged constructs march across corrupted earth.
history: Formed when Discord energy ruptured into a stable warfront.
War‑Shades began manifesting in organized formations.
Muramite warlords used the battleground to test new legion tactics.
Discord‑forged constructs were deployed to reinforce the front.
The battlefield became a permanent conflict nexus.
